package verify

import "github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/mutation"

// The must-NOT-trip fixture for the assignment arm.

// Through the carrier, wrapped in a method call — the accepted shape the live
// tree uses.
func writeThroughCarrier(err error) LanguageRun {
	return LanguageRun{
		Tool:  "stryker",
		Error: mutation.RecordLegError(err).String(),
	}
}

// A conversion wrapping the carrier's return is still the carrier.
func writeThroughConversion(err error) LanguageRun {
	var lr LanguageRun
	lr.Error = string(mutation.RecordLegError(err).String())
	return lr
}

// A COPY of an already-declared field. LegSummary.Error is populated from
// LanguageRun.Error, which is itself Recorded, so the guarantee travels with the
// value — requiring a no-op re-wrap here would be ceremony, not safety.
func copyFromDeclaredField(lr LanguageRun) LegSummary {
	return LegSummary{
		Tool:  lr.Tool,
		Error: lr.Error,
	}
}

// A raw fmt.Sprintf into a NotToolStream field is ACCEPTED. This is the shape
// lifecycle.go uses for Mutant.Note, and a guard that failed it would be
// unadoptable rather than fail-closed.
func writeNotToolStream(m *OutOfScopeMutant, target string) {
	m.Note = "routed to " + target
}
